title: Equivalence of Covering Supercuspidal Data
body_html:
Equivalence of Covering Supercuspidal Data

Two covering data \[ \widetilde\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho,\xi),\qquad \widetilde\Sigma'=(x',\Gamma',\phi',\rho',\xi') \] are equivalent if there exists \(g\in G\) such that the underlying points and semisimple elements satisfy \[ x=gx',\qquad \operatorname{Ad}_g(\Gamma')\in \Gamma+\mathbf g_{x,0}, \] and the quotient representations become isomorphic after transporting by \(g\) and comparing the two splittings of the cover.

Equivalently, the ordinary condition \[ \rho'\otimes\phi'\simeq(\rho\otimes\phi) ∘ \operatorname{Ad}_g \] is modified by the character measuring the difference between \(\xi'\) and the transported splitting. The attached genuine supercuspidal representations are isomorphic exactly when the covering data are equivalent.
